verificationScope: QA49601/49602: native super-infinite evolution accepts two creatures or Shinkalize, a single evolution with a noncreature source, a two-card HDM God, actual combined Volzeos King Cells and actual awakened Don Mashumaro Psychic Link. HDM and Don are registered native representatives of the two-card link rules; unregistered named examples Endless/Delete and Volg Isolate were not falsely registered or claimed as literal tests. One creature alone and attached Aura/Gear do not provide the second evolution card. QA49606: attack is declared with exactly sixteen own grave cards, returns four to twelve and still completes its actual Q-break attack; owner orders all four before the opponent chooses one physical field/hand card. Native Shield Force, hand-only entry for both players and noncreature elements, simultaneous group source timing, original owner destinations, stale incarnations and encrypted service decisions are covered. All 100 focused, 492 filtered related and five online cases pass. Legacy whole-game/worker/random legal-play loops and the full npm test were excluded, with their prior unverified status preserved.

resolvedAttempts.name: official-1821
resolvedAttempts.reason: Initial official fetch failed only under the network sandbox; the authorized official read-only retry passed. Initial focused fixtures called a non-exported allLayers helper, incorrectly used a Shinkalize seed as a negative example, used a newly summoned non-haste attacker, omitted a real GR Aura host and incremented undefined zoneSerial; corrected those fixtures from actual registered definitions. Replaced an incorrect power-overwrite spec with existing additive g205Aura and replaced granted recipient protection with existing direct self/other non-destruction effects so ignored recipients remain protected by the source. Added native simultaneous entry source snapshots and original-owner deck options, then completed 100/100 focused cases. The expanded related selector inadvertently included No25 138/460-game loops, then its separate 40-seed random-play loop; stopped only those newly started process groups at under ten minutes, retained both raw interrupted logs, excluded all game/worker/random-play groups and completed the final bounded card-effects regression 492/492. These stopped broad groups have no overall pass claim; the older full-suite and pending arrays remain unchanged.
